name: Instagram
description: Instagram is a social media app for sharing photos, videos, and reels. Primary workflows include browsing the home feed, exploring content via a grid, watching and interacting with reels, searching for users, and following accounts.

workflows.name: navigate_to_explore
workflows.steps: From the home feed, tap the 'Search and explore' tab (magnifying glass icon) in the bottom navigation bar. The explore page shows a 3-column grid of reels and photos with view-count overlays and a 'Search with Meta AI' bar at the top.

workflows.name: like_posts_from_explore
workflows.steps: On the explore page, tap a grid tile to open the post in the full-screen reel viewer. Tap the 'Like' button (heart icon, id=like_button) on the right side. The heart turns red when liked. To like the next post, swipe left on the pager (clips_viewer_view_pager) to advance to the next reel, then tap 'Like' again. Repeat for the desired number of posts.

workflows.name: navigate_to_reels
workflows.steps: From the home feed or explore page, tap the 'Reels' tab (clapperboard icon) in the bottom navigation bar to open the reels feed.

workflows.name: like_reels
workflows.steps: In the reels feed or reel viewer, tap the 'Like' button (heart icon, id=like_button) on the right side to like the current reel. The heart turns red when liked. Swipe left on the pager (clips_viewer_view_pager) to advance to the next reel and repeat.

workflows.name: search_and_follow_user
workflows.steps: Tap the 'Search and explore' tab in the bottom navigation. Tap the 'Search with Meta AI' bar at the top, type the username, and tap the correct result. On the user's profile, tap the 'Follow' button.

nuances: The reel viewer's Like button (id=like_button) toggles and shows a selected state (red heart) when liked.
In the reel viewer, swipe left on clips_viewer_view_pager to advance to the next reel; the pager may not always advance on the first swipe.
The explore page grid tiles open directly into the full-screen reel viewer, not a separate post detail screen.
The bottom navigation bar has 5 tabs: Home, Reels, Message, Search and explore, Profile.
recommendations: When liking multiple posts or reels, verify the Like button state (red heart) after each tap to confirm the action succeeded.
If a swipe does not advance the reel pager, retry the swipe before concluding the app is stuck.
Use the bottom navigation tabs to switch between Home, Reels, and Explore; do not rely on back button to exit the reel viewer.
